{
  "metadata": {
    "patch_id": "LIC-P023-SCOPE-FIX",
    "patch_name": "Staging Buffer Scope Isolation Fix - CRITICAL",
    "base_version": "v10.23",
    "target_version": "v10.23.1",
    "severity": "CRITICAL",
    "created_date": "2025-10-15",
    "author": "System (based on Job Workflow v1.6.3 fix)",
    "status": "URGENT_DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED",
    "bug_reference": "Same bug as Job Workflow BUG-1.6.2-001"
  },

  "bug_analysis": {
    "bug_id": "LIC-BUG-10.23-001",
    "title": "QA Engine V2 can still access Artist metadata despite ignore_artist_metadata flags",
    "severity": "CRITICAL",
    "root_cause": "Validation functions have access to both Artist output AND staging_buffer in scope",
    "evidence": {
      "job_workflow_precedent": "v1.6.2 had identical issue - 'ignore' flags insufficient",
      "job_workflow_symptom": "QA reported 129 words but actual text was 111 words",
      "lic_vulnerability": "LIC v10.23 has same architecture flaw - no hard scope isolation",
      "risk": "Artist can claim '215 words' in metadata while actual is '268 words', validation may read wrong source"
    },
    "impact": {
      "false_positives": "Messages may pass validation despite violating constraints",
      "user_trust": "Cannot trust QA validation results",
      "smoke_tests": "Current smoke tests don't verify scope isolation",
      "v10.23_objective": "FAILED - staging buffer not truly isolated"
    }
  },

  "fix_strategy": {
    "approach": "HARD_SCOPE_ISOLATION (proven in Job Workflow v1.6.3)",
    "enforcement": [
      "Delete Artist output from scope BEFORE calling any validation",
      "Validation function signatures accept ONLY staging_buffer parameter",
      "Add scope violation detection to every validation batch",
      "QA reports must include scope isolation verification section"
    ]
  },

  "changes": [
    {
      "change_id": "LIC-023.1-001",
      "section": "5.5.staging_buffer",
      "module": "extraction_logic",
      "action": "ENHANCEMENT_APPEND",
      "description": "Add Artist output deletion step after staging buffer creation",
      
      "append_after": "step_8",
      
      "new_content": {
        "step_9": "Create backup: artist_output_backup = deepcopy(artist_output)",
        "step_10": "DELETE from scope: del artist_output (enforces scope isolation)",
        "step_11": "Verification: assert 'artist_output' not in locals()",
        "step_12": "All validation passes staging_buffer ONLY",
        "step_13": "After validation: Restore artist_output_backup for final message rendering",
        
        "scope_isolation_enforcement": {
          "critical_rule": "After step_10, artist_output MUST NOT exist in any scope accessible to validation",
          "implementation": {
            "python_pseudocode": [
              "# Step 6: Store in staging_buffer",
              "staging_buffer = {",
              "  'K.1_greeting_actual': {'raw_text': k1_text, 'word_count': len(k1_text.split())},",
              "  'K.3_body_actual': {'raw_text': k3_text, 'word_count': len(k3_text.split())},",
              "  ...",
              "}",
              "",
              "# Step 9: Backup for later file rendering",
              "artist_output_backup = deepcopy(artist_output)",
              "",
              "# Step 10: DELETE to enforce scope isolation",
              "del artist_output",
              "",
              "# Step 11: Verification",
              "if 'artist_output' in dir():",
              "    raise ScopeViolationError('Artist output still accessible after deletion')",
              "",
              "# Step 12: Validation can ONLY see staging_buffer",
              "validation_result = run_all_qa_validations(staging_buffer)  # NO artist_output parameter",
              "",
              "# Step 13: Restore for file rendering",
              "if validation_result.passed:",
              "    artist_output = artist_output_backup",
              "    render_final_message(staging_buffer, artist_output_backup)"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },

    {
      "change_id": "LIC-023.1-002",
      "section": "6.validation.qa_engine_v2",
      "module": "validation_batches",
      "action": "DESTRUCTIVE_OVERWRITE",
      "description": "Rewrite validation batch signatures to accept ONLY staging_buffer",
      
      "old_block": {
        "note": "Current design allows both staging_buffer and artist_output in scope",
        "vulnerability": "Validation could accidentally read artist_output instead of staging_buffer"
      },
      
      "new_block": {
        "function_signatures": {
          "run_validation_batch_1": "def run_validation_batch_1(staging_buffer: dict) -> ValidationResult",
          "run_validation_batch_2": "def run_validation_batch_2(staging_buffer: dict) -> ValidationResult",
          "run_validation_batch_3": "def run_validation_batch_3(staging_buffer: dict) -> ValidationResult",
          "run_validation_batch_4": "def run_validation_batch_4(staging_buffer: dict) -> ValidationResult",
          "critical_note": "NO artist_output parameter - enforced by function signature"
        },
        
        "parameter_validation": {
          "execute_first": "Before any validation logic in each batch",
          "check": "if 'artist_output' in dir() or 'artist_output' in globals(): raise ScopeViolationError()",
          "error_message": "CRITICAL: artist_output accessible during validation - scope isolation violated"
        },
        
        "data_source_enforcement": {
          "K.1_word_count": "word_count = staging_buffer['K.1_greeting_actual']['word_count']",
          "K.3_word_count": "word_count = staging_buffer['K.3_body_actual']['word_count']",
          "K.5_word_count": "word_count = staging_buffer['K.5_cta_actual']['word_count']",
          "full_message_word_count": "word_count = staging_buffer['full_message_actual']['word_count']",
          "verification": "These counts were calculated as len(staging_buffer[section]['raw_text'].split())",
          "critical_rule": "NEVER recalculate from Artist output - staging_buffer is ground truth"
        }
      }
    },

    {
      "change_id": "LIC-023.1-003",
      "section": "6.validation.qa_engine_v2",
      "module": "gate_decision_pattern",
      "action": "ENHANCEMENT_APPEND",
      "description": "Add scope isolation verification to gate decision logic",
      
      "append_before": "try:",
      
      "new_content": {
        "scope_isolation_verification": {
          "check_1": "Verify artist_output deleted",
          "implementation_1": "if 'artist_output' in locals() or 'artist_output' in globals(): raise ScopeViolationError('artist_output not deleted before validation')",
          
          "check_2": "Verify staging_buffer populated",
          "implementation_2": "if 'staging_buffer' not in locals(): raise ScopeViolationError('staging_buffer not created')",
          
          "check_3": "Verify staging_buffer has required sections",
          "implementation_3": "required = ['K.1_greeting_actual', 'K.3_body_actual', 'full_message_actual']; for section in required: assert section in staging_buffer"
        },
        
        "updated_gate_logic": {
          "pseudocode": [
            "# SCOPE ISOLATION VERIFICATION",
            "if 'artist_output' in dir():",
            "    raise ScopeViolationError('Artist output still accessible - scope isolation failed')",
            "",
            "# VALIDATION EXECUTION",
            "try:",
            "    run_validation_batch_1(staging_buffer)  # ONLY staging_buffer parameter",
            "    run_validation_batch_2(staging_buffer)  # Artist output CANNOT be accessed",
            "    run_validation_batch_3(staging_buffer)",
            "    run_validation_batch_4(staging_buffer)",
            "    all_validations_pass = True",
            "except FatalValidationException as e:",
            "    all_validations_pass = False",
            "    failure_report = generate_failure_report(e, staging_buffer)",
            "",
            "# GATE DECISION",
            "if all_validations_pass:",
            "    artist_output = artist_output_backup  # Restore for file rendering",
            "    write_final_message_file(staging_buffer.full_message_actual.raw_text)",
            "else:",
            "    display_failure_report(failure_report)",
            "    DO_NOT_WRITE_FILE"
          ]
        }
      }
    },

    {
      "change_id": "LIC-023.1-004",
      "section": "6.validation.qa_engine_v2.validation_batches",
      "module": "ALL_BATCHES",
      "action": "ENHANCEMENT_APPEND",
      "description": "Add mandatory scope check as first step in every validation batch",
      
      "append_to": "Beginning of each batch function (batch_1, batch_2, batch_3, batch_4)",
      
      "new_content": {
        "mandatory_scope_check": {
          "execute_first": "Before ANY validation logic",
          "implementation": [
            "# MANDATORY SCOPE ISOLATION CHECK",
            "if 'artist_output' in dir():",
            "    raise ScopeViolationError(",
            "        f'Batch {batch_id}: artist_output accessible during validation',",
            "        batch_id=batch_id,",
            "        accessible_vars=dir()",
            "    )",
            "",
            "# Verify we have staging_buffer",
            "if 'staging_buffer' not in locals():",
            "    raise ScopeViolationError(f'Batch {batch_id}: staging_buffer not provided')",
            "",
            "# Proceed with validation using ONLY staging_buffer"
          ],
          "on_violation": "HALT_WORKFLOW immediately with scope violation error report"
        }
      }
    },

    {
      "change_id": "LIC-023.1-005",
      "section": "6.validation",
      "module": "master_validation_gate",
      "action": "ENHANCEMENT_APPEND",
      "description": "Add scope isolation results to validation gate reporting",
      
      "new_content": {
        "scope_isolation_reporting": {
          "section_name": "Scope Isolation Verification",
          "display_location": "Before validation batch results",
          "content": {
            "artist_output_deleted": "boolean - True if del artist_output executed",
            "artist_output_accessible": "boolean - False if scope check passes",
            "staging_buffer_created": "boolean - True if staging_buffer populated",
            "scope_check_results": [
              {
                "batch": "batch_1_constraint_compliance",
                "artist_output_accessible": false,
                "scope_check_passed": true
              },
              {
                "batch": "batch_2_confidence_validation",
                "artist_output_accessible": false,
                "scope_check_passed": true
              },
              {
                "batch": "batch_3_entity_validation",
                "artist_output_accessible": false,
                "scope_check_passed": true
              },
              {
                "batch": "batch_4_format_validation",
                "artist_output_accessible": false,
                "scope_check_passed": true
              }
            ]
          },
          "display_format": {
            "table": true,
            "columns": ["Validation Batch", "Artist Output Accessible?", "Scope Check", "Status"],
            "pass_criteria": "All batches show 'NO' for artist_output_accessible"
          }
        }
      }
    },

    {
      "change_id": "LIC-023.1-006",
      "section": "8.deployment.smoke_test_suite",
      "module": "scope_isolation_tests",
      "action": "ENHANCEMENT_APPEND",
      "description": "Add scope isolation test suite (12 tests) to verify hard isolation",
      
      "new_content": {
        "test_suite_id": "SCOPE_ISOLATION_TESTS",
        "priority": "CRITICAL - Must pass before v10.23.1 deployment",
        "total_tests": 12,
        
        "unit_tests": [
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-UNIT-001",
            "name": "Artist output deletion verification",
            "check": "After staging buffer creation, verify artist_output deleted from scope",
            "method": "Try to access artist_output variable - should raise NameError",
            "expected": "NameError: name 'artist_output' is not defined",
            "critical": true
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-UNIT-002",
            "name": "Validation function signature check",
            "check": "Verify all validation batch functions accept ONLY staging_buffer parameter",
            "method": "Inspect function signatures using inspect.signature()",
            "expected": "All functions have signature: (staging_buffer: dict)",
            "critical": true
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-UNIT-003",
            "name": "Staging buffer word count source verification",
            "check": "Verify staging_buffer word counts calculated from raw_text",
            "method": "Recalculate: len(staging_buffer['K.3_body_actual']['raw_text'].split())",
            "expected": "Recalculated count EXACTLY matches staging_buffer['K.3_body_actual']['word_count']",
            "critical": true
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-UNIT-004",
            "name": "Scope check in validation batches",
            "check": "Verify each batch has mandatory scope check as first step",
            "method": "Code inspection - look for 'if artist_output in dir()' at function start",
            "expected": "All 4 batches have scope check before validation logic",
            "critical": true
          }
        ],
        
        "integration_tests": [
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-INT-001",
            "name": "Artist metadata corruption test",
            "check": "Corrupt artist_output metadata before deletion, verify validation unaffected",
            "method": [
              "Set artist_output['K.3']['word_count'] = 999 (intentionally wrong)",
              "Create staging_buffer with actual K.3 word_count = 215",
              "Delete artist_output",
              "Run validation",
              "Verify validation uses 215 (staging_buffer), not 999 (corrupted artist)"
            ],
            "expected": "Validation passes with 215 words, ignores corrupted 999",
            "critical": true
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-INT-002",
            "name": "Scope violation detection test",
            "check": "Simulate scope violation by NOT deleting artist_output",
            "method": [
              "Create staging_buffer",
              "DO NOT delete artist_output (simulate bug)",
              "Attempt to run validation",
              "Verify ScopeViolationError raised before any validation executes"
            ],
            "expected": "ScopeViolationError raised with message about artist_output accessibility",
            "critical": true
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-INT-003",
            "name": "E2E word count accuracy test",
            "check": "Generate message, manually count words, compare to QA report",
            "method": [
              "Generate INMAIL message with K.3 body",
              "Extract K.3 raw_text from staging_buffer",
              "Calculate: len(k3_text.split())",
              "Compare to validation result word count"
            ],
            "expected": "Manual count EXACTLY matches validation word count (zero discrepancy)",
            "critical": true
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-INT-004",
            "name": "Backup and restore test",
            "check": "Verify artist_output_backup correctly restored after validation",
            "method": [
              "Create artist_output with known content",
              "Create staging_buffer and backup",
              "Delete artist_output",
              "Run validation (passes)",
              "Verify artist_output restored with correct content for file rendering"
            ],
            "expected": "artist_output_backup content matches original, available for rendering",
            "critical": false
          }
        ],
        
        "smoke_tests": [
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001",
            "name": "Manual verification test (CRITICAL)",
            "check": "User manually verifies word count accuracy",
            "method": [
              "Generate INMAIL message for EXECUTIVE archetype",
              "Copy K.3 body text from QA report or final message",
              "Paste into Microsoft Word",
              "Check Tools → Word Count",
              "Compare to QA validation report word count"
            ],
            "expected": "Word count in MS Word EXACTLY matches QA report (zero phantom words)",
            "critical": true,
            "priority": "P0",
            "regression_test": true,
            "notes": "This is the SAME test that failed in Job Workflow v1.6.2"
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-002",
            "name": "Over-limit detection with scope isolation",
            "check": "Verify over-limit violation detected using staging_buffer only",
            "method": [
              "Generate K.3 with 268 words (over 250 limit)",
              "Artist claims 215 words in metadata (false claim)",
              "Delete artist_output before validation",
              "Run validation",
              "Verify validation detects 268 (staging_buffer), not 215 (deleted artist)"
            ],
            "expected": "Validation fails with message: 'K.3 word count 268 exceeds maximum 250'",
            "critical": true
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-003",
            "name": "Under-limit detection with scope isolation",
            "check": "Verify under-limit violation detected using staging_buffer only",
            "method": [
              "Generate K.3 with 165 words (under 180 minimum)",
              "Artist claims 200 words in metadata (false claim)",
              "Delete artist_output before validation",
              "Run validation",
              "Verify validation detects 165 (staging_buffer), not 200 (deleted artist)"
            ],
            "expected": "Validation fails with message: 'K.3 word count 165 below minimum 180'",
            "critical": true
          },
          {
            "test_id": "LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-004",
            "name": "Scope isolation report verification",
            "check": "Verify validation gate report includes scope isolation section",
            "method": [
              "Generate any message",
              "Run validation",
              "Check validation report for 'Scope Isolation Verification' section",
              "Verify all batches show artist_output_accessible = false"
            ],
            "expected": "Report includes scope isolation table with all checks passing",
            "critical": false
          }
        ],
        
        "acceptance_criteria": {
          "unit_tests_pass_rate": "100% (4/4)",
          "integration_tests_pass_rate": "100% (4/4)",
          "smoke_tests_pass_rate": "100% (4/4)",
          "critical_tests_pass_rate": "100% (9/9 critical tests)",
          "manual_verification": "LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 MUST pass (user validates in MS Word)",
          "deployment_blocker": "Any critical test failure blocks v10.23.1 deployment"
        }
      }
    },

    {
      "change_id": "LIC-023.1-007",
      "section": "6.validation.critical_implementation_notes",
      "module": "scope_isolation_rules",
      "action": "ENHANCEMENT_APPEND",
      "description": "Add hard scope isolation rules to critical implementation notes",
      
      "append_to": "critical_implementation_notes array",
      
      "new_content": [
        "SCOPE ISOLATION: After staging buffer creation, artist_output MUST be deleted: del artist_output",
        "SCOPE ISOLATION: Validation functions signature: def validate(staging_buffer: dict) - NO artist_output parameter",
        "SCOPE ISOLATION: Every validation batch MUST check: if 'artist_output' in dir(): raise ScopeViolationError()",
        "SCOPE ISOLATION: QA reports word counts MUST come from staging_buffer[section]['word_count']",
        "SCOPE ISOLATION: Test LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 (manual MS Word verification) MUST pass before production",
        "SCOPE ISOLATION: Backup artist_output before deletion: artist_output_backup = deepcopy(artist_output)",
        "SCOPE ISOLATION: Restore after validation: artist_output = artist_output_backup (for file rendering only)"
      ]
    }
  ],

  "validation_checkpoints": [
    {
      "checkpoint_id": "LIC-V-023.1-001",
      "name": "Scope Isolation Implementation Verification",
      "when": "After applying all changes",
      "checks": [
        "Verify artist_output deleted after staging buffer creation (step 10)",
        "Verify all validation batch functions accept ONLY staging_buffer parameter",
        "Verify scope check in all 4 validation batches",
        "Verify artist_output_backup created before deletion",
        "Verify artist_output restored after validation passes"
      ],
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "on_fail": "DO NOT DEPLOY - scope isolation not implemented"
    },
    {
      "checkpoint_id": "LIC-V-023.1-002",
      "name": "Scope Isolation Test Suite Execution",
      "when": "Before deployment",
      "checks": [
        "Execute all 12 SCOPE_ISOLATION_TESTS",
        "Verify 100% pass rate on all tests",
        "Verify all 9 critical tests pass",
        "Execute LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 (manual MS Word verification)"
      ],
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "on_fail": "DO NOT DEPLOY - scope isolation tests failed"
    },
    {
      "checkpoint_id": "LIC-V-023.1-003",
      "name": "Regression Test Verification",
      "when": "After deployment to test environment",
      "checks": [
        "Run original v10.23 smoke tests (4 tests)",
        "Verify all original tests still pass",
        "Verify no functionality regressions",
        "Verify word count accuracy improved (zero phantom counts)"
      ],
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "on_fail": "ROLLBACK to v10.23 - scope fix broke existing functionality"
    }
  ],

  "deployment_instructions": {
    "urgency": "CRITICAL - Deploy immediately to prevent false positives",
    
    "pre_deployment": [
      "1. DO NOT deploy v10.23 to production (has scope isolation bug)",
      "2. Apply all 7 changes from this patch (LIC-023.1-001 through LIC-023.1-007)",
      "3. Run SCOPE_ISOLATION_TESTS suite (12 tests)",
      "4. Verify 100% pass rate on all tests",
      "5. Execute manual verification test (LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001)"
    ],
    
    "deployment": [
      "1. Deploy v10.23.1 (with scope isolation fix) to test environment",
      "2. Generate 3 test messages (INMAIL, CONNECTION_REQ, FOLLOW_UP)",
      "3. For each message:",
      "   - Extract K.3 text",
      "   - Calculate word count in MS Word",
      "   - Compare to QA report",
      "   - Verify EXACT match (zero discrepancy)",
      "4. If all 3 match perfectly → proceed to production",
      "5. If ANY mismatch → DO NOT DEPLOY, debug scope isolation"
    ],
    
    "post_deployment": [
      "1. Monitor for scope violation errors",
      "2. Track word count accuracy metrics",
      "3. Collect user feedback on QA report accuracy",
      "4. Run regression tests daily for first week",
      "5. If any scope violations detected → immediate rollback and investigation"
    ]
  },

  "success_criteria": {
    "definition_of_done": [
      "✅ artist_output deleted after staging buffer creation",
      "✅ All validation functions accept ONLY staging_buffer parameter",
      "✅ Scope check in all 4 validation batches",
      "✅ All 12 SCOPE_ISOLATION_TESTS pass (100%)",
      "✅ LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 passes (MS Word count matches QA report)",
      "✅ Zero phantom word counts",
      "✅ Zero scope violation errors",
      "✅ Validation gate report includes scope isolation verification section"
    ],
    
    "failure_indicators": [
      "❌ artist_output accessible during validation",
      "❌ Word count in MS Word differs from QA report by even 1 word",
      "❌ Validation functions still have artist_output parameter",
      "❌ Any SCOPE_ISOLATION_TEST fails",
      "❌ ScopeViolationError not raised when artist_output accessible"
    ]
  },

  "regression_prevention": {
    "mandatory_test": "LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 (Manual MS Word Verification)",
    "frequency": "Every production deployment",
    "acceptance_criteria": "100% match between MS Word count and QA report",
    "on_failure": "Immediate rollback and scope isolation audit",
    "notes": "This is the SAME test that caught the Job Workflow v1.6.2 bug"
  },

  "lessons_from_job_workflow": {
    "what_failed_in_v1.6.2": [
      "Documentation said 'read from staging_buffer' but wasn't enforced",
      "Had 'ignore_artist_metadata' flags but validation still read artist metadata",
      "QA reported 129 words but actual text was 111 words (18 word phantom count)",
      "User discovered bug via MANUAL_001 test (MS Word verification)"
    ],
    
    "what_fixed_it_in_v1.6.3": [
      "HARD scope isolation: del artist_output before validation",
      "Function signatures enforced: def validate(staging_buffer: dict) ONLY",
      "Scope checks in every validation: if 'artist_output' in dir(): raise ScopeViolationError()",
      "Comprehensive test suite: 12 tests including manual MS Word verification"
    ],
    
    "applied_to_lic_v10.23.1": [
      "Same hard scope isolation pattern",
      "Same function signature enforcement",
      "Same scope check in every validation batch",
      "Same manual verification test (LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001)",
      "Same backup/restore pattern for artist_output"
    ]
  }
}
